description: Project scaffolding: create all directory structures, package.json files, config files, Prisma schema, migrations, and seed script. This is the foundation every other FEAT depends on.
steps: Step 1 — Create server/package.json with: name='oma-midas-server', type='module', main='server.js', scripts: {start:'node server.js', dev:'nodemon server.js', seed:'node src/prisma/seed.js'}. Dependencies: express, @prisma/client, prisma (dev), bcryptjs, jsonwebtoken, cookie-parser, cors, dotenv, zod, nodemailer, node-cron, express-rate-limit, helmet, morgan, nodemon (dev), uuid, axios, @sentry/node. Use exact pinned versions: express@4.18.2, @prisma/client@5.14.0, prisma@5.14.0, bcryptjs@2.4.3, jsonwebtoken@9.0.2, cookie-parser@1.4.6, cors@2.8.5, dotenv@16.4.5, zod@3.23.8, nodemailer@6.9.14, node-cron@3.0.3, express-rate-limit@7.3.1, helmet@7.1.0, morgan@1.10.0, nodemon@3.1.4, uuid@10.0.0, axios@1.7.2.

Step 2 — Create server/.env.example with every required variable: PORT=5000, DATABASE_URL=postgresql://..., JWT_SECRET=your_jwt_secret_here, JWT_EXPIRES_IN=7d, PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_..., PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY=pk_test_..., FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:5173, EMAIL_HOST=smtp.gmail.com, EMAIL_PORT=587, EMAIL_USER=your@email.com, EMAIL_PASS=your_app_password, EMAIL_FROM='Oma Midas <noreply@omamidas.com>', NODE_ENV=development, SENTRY_DSN= (optional). Add a comment block explaining each variable.

Step 3 — Create server/src/prisma/schema.prisma with datasource db (provider=postgresql, url=env('DATABASE_URL'), directUrl=env('DATABASE_URL')), generator client (provider='prisma-client-js'). Define ALL models exactly as specified:
  - User: id String @id @default(cuid()), fullName String, email String @unique, phone String, passwordHash String, role Role @default(MEMBER), status UserStatus @default(PENDING), memberType MemberType @default(NEW), bankName String, accountNumber String, accountName String, paystackRecipientCode String?, createdAt DateTime @default(now()), updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt, deletedAt DateTime?, contributions Contribution[], loans Loan[], refunds Refund[], ledgerEntries LedgerEntry[], notifications Notification[], auditLogs AuditLog[]. @@index([email]), @@index([status]), @@index([role]).
  - Cycle: id String @id @default(cuid()), startDate DateTime, endDate DateTime, isActive Boolean @default(false), createdAt DateTime @default(now()), contributions Contribution[], loans Loan[], refunds Refund[]. @@index([isActive]).
  - Contribution: id String @id @default(cuid()), userId String, cycleId String, month Int, year Int, amountKobo Int, status ContributionStatus @default(PENDING), paystackRef String? @unique, paidAt DateTime?, createdAt DateTime @default(now()), user User @relation(fields:[userId], references:[id]), cycle Cycle @relation(fields:[cycleId], references:[id]). @@unique([userId, cycleId, month, year]), @@index([userId]), @@index([cycleId]), @@index([paystackRef]).
  - Loan: id String @id @default(cuid()), userId String, cycleId String, requestedAmountKobo Int, feeKobo Int, disbursedAmountKobo Int, totalRepayableKobo Int, status LoanStatus @default(PENDING), rejectionReason String?, paystackTransferCode String?, repaymentMonths Int, createdAt DateTime @default(now()), updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt, user User @relation(fields:[userId], references:[id]), cycle Cycle @relation(fields:[cycleId], references:[id]), installments LoanInstallment[], ledgerEntries LedgerEntry[]. @@index([userId]), @@index([cycleId]), @@index([status]).
  - LoanInstallment: id String @id @default(cuid()), loanId String, dueDate DateTime, amountKobo Int, status InstallmentStatus @default(PENDING), paystackRef String? @unique, paidAt DateTime?, createdAt DateTime @default(now()), loan Loan @relation(fields:[loanId], references:[id]). @@index([loanId]), @@index([status]), @@index([dueDate]).
  - Refund: id String @id @default(cuid()), userId String, cycleId String, amountKobo Int, status RefundStatus @default(PENDING), rejectionReason String?, paystackTransferCode String?, createdAt DateTime @default(now()), updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt, user User @relation(fields:[userId], references:[id]), cycle Cycle @relation(fields:[cycleId], references:[id]). @@index([userId]), @@index([status]).
  - LedgerEntry: id String @id @default(cuid()), type LedgerType, ledger LedgerBook, userId String?, loanId String?, amountKobo Int, balanceAfterKobo Int, reference String @unique, createdAt DateTime @default(now()), user User? @relation(fields:[userId], references:[id]), loan Loan? @relation(fields:[loanId], references:[id]). @@index([ledger]), @@index([userId]), @@index([reference]).
  - Notification: id String @id @default(cuid()), userId String, title String, message String, type String, isRead Boolean @default(false), createdAt DateTime @default(now()), user User @relation(fields:[userId], references:[id]). @@index([userId]), @@index([isRead]).
  - AuditLog: id String @id @default(cuid()), adminId String, action String, targetType String, targetId String?, metadata Json?, createdAt DateTime @default(now()), admin User @relation(fields:[adminId], references:[id]). @@index([adminId]), @@index([createdAt]).
  - Setting: id String @id @default(cuid()), key String @unique, value String, updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt.
  Enums: Role {MEMBER ADMIN}, UserStatus {PENDING ACTIVE REJECTED INACTIVE}, MemberType {NEW EXISTING}, ContributionStatus {PENDING PAID}, LoanStatus {PENDING APPROVED REJECTED DISBURSED REPAYING COMPLETED}, InstallmentStatus {PENDING PAID OVERDUE}, RefundStatus {PENDING APPROVED REJECTED TRANSFERRED FAILED}, LedgerType {CONTRIBUTION LOAN_DISBURSEMENT LOAN_REPAYMENT LOAN_FEE REFUND FUND_TOPUP}, LedgerBook {SAVINGS COMPANY_FUND}.

Step 4 — Create server/src/prisma/seed.js (ES module). It must: (a) import PrismaClient, bcryptjs; (b) hash a password for the admin account (email: admin@omamidas.com, password: Admin@Midas2024!, fullName: 'Oma Midas Admin', role: ADMIN, status: ACTIVE); (c) upsert the admin user by email; (d) upsert all settings rows: fee_percentage='30', loan_multiplier='3', min_consecutive_months='3', terms_and_conditions='

Terms and conditions for Oma Midas Global Limited cooperative membership...

' (full placeholder HTML paragraph); (e) upsert the current active cycle with startDate=new Date('2024-10-01'), endDate=new Date('2025-09-30'), isActive=true; (f) log 'Seed complete' and disconnect. Run with `node src/prisma/seed.js` from server/.

Step 5 — Create server/src/utils/kobo.js: export function koboToNaira(kobo) returns kobo/100 rounded to 2dp as a number. Export function nairaToKobo(naira) returns Math.round(naira*100) as integer. Export function formatNaira(kobo) returns formatted string '₦1,234.56'. Export function calculateLoanBreakdown(requestedKobo, feePercentage) returns {requestedAmountKobo, feeKobo, disbursedAmountKobo, totalRepayableKobo} all integers — feeKobo=Math.round(requestedKobo*(feePercentage/100)), disbursedAmountKobo=requestedKobo-feeKobo, totalRepayableKobo=requestedKobo.

Step 6 — Create server/src/utils/token.js: export function generateToken(payload, secret, expiresIn) returns signed JWT. Export function verifyToken(token, secret) returns decoded payload or throws. Export function generateResetToken() returns a UUID v4 string. Export function hashResetToken(token) returns SHA256 hex hash (using Node crypto module).

Step 7 — Create server/src/utils/logger.js: export a logger object with methods: info(msg, meta), warn(msg, meta), error(msg, meta). Each method prepends ISO timestamp. If process.env.SENTRY_DSN is set, import @sentry/node and call Sentry.init in this file then call Sentry.captureException for errors. Never log values of passwords, JWT secrets, or Paystack secret keys. Export as default.

Step 8 — Create client/package.json with: name='oma-midas-client', type='module', scripts: {dev:'vite', build:'vite build', preview:'vite preview'}. Dependencies: react@18.3.1, react-dom@18.3.1, react-router-dom@6.24.0, framer-motion@11.2.12, axios@1.7.2. DevDependencies: vite@5.3.1, @vitejs/plugin-react@4.3.1, tailwindcss@3.4.4, postcss@8.4.39, autoprefixer@10.4.19.

Step 10 — Create client/vite.config.js: import defineConfig from vite, import react plugin. Export config with plugins:[react()], server:{proxy:{'/api':{target:'http://localhost:5000', changeOrigin:true}}}.

Step 11 — Create client/tailwind.config.js: content: ['./index.html','./src/**/*.{js,jsx}']. Theme extend: colors {primary:'#4A1D4F', accent:'#C9A86A', blush:'#F4E1E6', background:'#FAF7F5', charcoal:'#2B2B2B', success:'#2E7D5B', warning:'#D9962B', error:'#B3392F'}. fontFamily: {heading:['Playfair Display','serif'], body:['Inter','sans-serif']}. borderRadius: {xl:'12px','2xl':'16px'}. boxShadow: {card:'0 2px 16px rgba(74,29,79,0.08)', hover:'0 4px 24px rgba(74,29,79,0.16)'}.

Step 13 — Create client/index.html: DOCTYPE html, lang=en, title='Oma Midas Global Limited', Google Fonts link for Playfair Display (weights 400,700) and Inter (weights 400,500,600,700), favicon link /favicon.ico, div#root, script src=/src/main.jsx type=module.

Step 14 — Create client/public/logo.svg: SVG 80x80, background circle fill=#4A1D4F, text 'OM' in Playfair Display fill=#C9A86A centered, small 5-point crown SVG path above the letters in fill=#C9A86A. Make it a clean, elegant monogram.

Step 15 — Create client/public/favicon.ico placeholder (can be the same design as logo but 32x32 — create as a 32x32 SVG named favicon.ico or reference the logo.svg). Actually create a minimal valid ICO-compatible SVG at client/public/favicon.svg and reference it in index.html as /favicon.svg.

Step 16 — Create client/src/styles/index.css: @tailwind base/components/utilities directives. CSS custom properties on :root for all design tokens (--color-primary, --color-accent, etc). Base styles: body uses font-body, background-color var(--bg), color var(--text). Heading tags use font-heading. Custom utility classes: .gold-divider (1px solid #C9A86A with opacity), .card-base (bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-card p-6), .btn-primary (bg-primary text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold hover:shadow-hover transition-all). Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block setting all transition/animation durations to 0.01ms.

Step 17 — Create server/src/prisma/ directory structure and run `npx prisma init` conceptually by ensuring the prisma/schema.prisma path matches what's in package.json prisma config field: add `'prisma': {'schema': 'src/prisma/schema.prisma'}` to server/package.json.
acceptance_criteria: `npm install` runs successfully in both server/ and client/ directories
`npx prisma generate` from server/ succeeds with schema at src/prisma/schema.prisma
`npm run build` from client/ exits 0 with Vite bundle output (even with placeholder pages)
server/src/prisma/seed.js runs with `node src/prisma/seed.js` from server/ and logs 'Seed complete'
All design tokens in tailwind.config.js match the spec exactly (primary: #4A1D4F, accent: #C9A86A, etc.)
client/public/logo.svg is a valid SVG with plum circle, gold OM monogram, and crown
verification: From server/: `npx prisma generate` — exits 0, generates Prisma client
From client/: `npm run build` — exits 0 (requires placeholder src/App.jsx and src/main.jsx to exist — create minimal stubs: App returns <div/>, main renders App)
findings: All 17 steps implemented. server/npm install: OK (229 packages, uuid deprecation warnings are non-blocking). npx prisma generate: OK (v5.14.0, schema at src/prisma/schema.prisma). client/npm install: OK (156 packages). client/npm run build: OK (Vite 5.3.1, 31 modules, 39s). Tailwind utility-class warning is expected on a stub build — no actual Tailwind classes are used in the placeholder App yet; tokens are defined via CSS custom properties in index.css.
